title: Receipt rollback is undetected; unreadable Store fails open to reuse
commons_coordination: No Commons record filed. Owning layer is mncs-test evidence admission (Store generation/monotonicity contract may belong to mncs-store).
observed_need: Swapping a receipt file for an older valid receipt (same schema, valid evidence_id) is admitted without remark, and verify_receipt_in_store returns match=True when the vault is unavailable or unreadable. Primary integrity rests on content-addressed evidence_id, but freshness/monotonicity is unchecked.
current_language_behavior: read_receipt validates schema, obligation, verdict vocabulary, and evidence_id over the core; act_on_verdict cross-checks the file receipt against the vault object for the same evidence_id only. No generation counter, no newest-wins rule, no alarm when the vault cannot be read.
why_insufficient: A stale PASS can mask a newer FAIL that exists only in the vault (or nowhere, after a crash between execution and file write in the other direction). Corruption that preserves evidence_id validity (bitrot in non-core fields, whole-file rollback) is silent.
minimal_reproducer: Record PASS at rev A, execute FAIL at rev B, restore the rev-A receipt file: the next verify reuses PASS (legacy or closure match) with no remark that newer evidence existed.
desired_direction: Bind receipts to a monotonic per-obligation generation (vault-owned counter or hash-chained previous_evidence_id verification against vault history); treat an unreadable vault as UNKNOWN rather than match when the receipt is not freshly executed.
workaround: None: content addressing still rejects tampered cores, and the previous_evidence_id chain records (but does not enforce) lineage.
